payload.scientific_problem: The repaired generic anchored-replacement proposer enters an eligible JAK2 amide-plus-diamine basin that shallow-v0 and progressive-v1 missed at equal zero-oracle proposal budget. Determine whether the novel locked endpoints have useful docking utility before integrating the lane with FiberControl.
payload.primary_model_output: A complete protected executable anchored-replacement program and its canonical eligible endpoint.
payload.central_claim_under_test: Coupling generic pendant deletion and saturated two-nitrogen ring construction at one retained anchor yields at least one novel JAK2 delta-0.6 endpoint with docking score at or below -10.0.
payload.validation_setting: One bounded answer-known JAK2 seed-1 delta-0.6 development panel; not held-out, not replicated, not a benchmark-wide IVG comparison.
payload.declared_support: Neutral charge-preserving 48-slot molecular graphs, at most 40 active atoms, one or two existing Dynamic-v1 modules, at most 32 primitives and eight blocks; exact executor; complete endpoint QED at least 0.6, SA at most 4.0, Morgan similarity at least 0.6 and COMPOSE structural validity.

authorization.basis: The user explicitly approved continuing the route-distilled plus FiberControl JAK2 direction, approved Modal use, requested a quick answer, and authorized the bounded work before this lock was scored.
authorization.scope: Exactly the 12 novel endpoints in the immutable candidate lock, one docking attempt each, no retry or replacement.

evaluator.protocol: Open Babel --gen3D followed by qvina02 against the unchanged JAK2 box; CPU 1 per ligand; best reported mode.

frozen_decision.promotion: Promote the anchored-replacement lane into a bounded FiberControl integration if at least one novel endpoint scores at or below -10.0.
frozen_decision.strong_signal: A score at or below the published IVG mean of -10.4 is a strong signal, subject to the known approximately 0.5 single-call docking variability.
frozen_decision.kill: If no novel endpoint reaches -10.0, do not claim the proposal repair alone closes the JAK2 gap; retain the zero-oracle support result and diagnose reward allocation or neighborhood refinement before a larger scored run.

payload.logging: The remote worker emits one line per completed locked query and the local entry point atomically seals the full query ledger and summary.
prohibitions: no candidate replacement, backfill or retry
no score-dependent modification of this lock
no structural distance used as a docking surrogate
no full benchmark or additional cell
no claim of held-out generalization or benchmark-wide IVG superiority
